user.title: Add a VRF air conditioner gateway

serial.title: Serial connection
serial.description:
Connect a USB-RS485 adapter or an RS232 port directly to the VRF gateway. Indoor units are discovered automatically after setup.

Detected serial ports: {ports}

data_description.brand: Use "Detect automatically" when you are not sure.
data_description.baud_rate: Must match the gateway settings, 9600 is common.
data_description.slave_addr: Address of the gateway on the bus, usually 1.
data_description.stopbits: VRF gateways normally use 1 stop bit; 2 stop bits makes the device go silent.

tcp.title: TCP connection
tcp.description: Connect to the VRF gateway through a serial-to-network module (TCP passthrough).

udp.title: UDP connection
udp.description: Connect to the VRF gateway through a serial-to-network module (UDP passthrough).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open this link. Check the device path / host, port, permissions and that no other program is using it.
error.serial_port_required: Please provide the serial port path.

abort.already_configured: A gateway is already configured for this link.

data_description.poll_interval: Lower values keep the state fresher but use the bus more.
data_description.discovery_interval: Used to find newly connected indoor units.
data_description.cleanup_offline_units: Remove the entity of an indoor unit that stopped reporting twice in a row.

rescan.description: Scan the VRF gateway again to find newly connected indoor units.
